title: Closed ringed counit is invertible
statement: Let i:Z to X be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion] and A a sheaf of commutative rings on the small pro-etale site. Form actual module inverse image [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] and the direct image given by base-change evaluation with action through the inverse-image ring unit [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every adjunction between these specified functors, its counit at every module sheaf is an isomorphism.

proof.text: For the specified module adjunction ai and closed module H, take the canonical abelian adjunct c of the forgotten module unit at ai.right(H). It is invertible by the unit-comparison theorem, which applies to every scheme morphism.

The module right triangle identity, mapped by the source forgetful functor, and the abelian Hom equivalence give c followed by the forgotten ai counit equal to the actual abelian counit at the underlying sheaf of H. The existing abelian closed-counit theorem makes the latter invertible. Cancel the invertible c and reflect isomorphisms with the module-to-abelian-sheaf functor.

proof_origin.place: Restricted abelian adjunction, combined with the already-stated abelian closed counit and the adjunction triangle identity.
